title: The Rat Bomb That Won by Getting Caught #history #shorts
description:
In World War Two, Britain's Special Operations Executive filled dead rats with plastic explosive, sewed them shut and fitted fuses. The idea: leave one on the coal pile in a German boiler room, and the stoker would toss it into the fire.

About a hundred rats were bought from a London supplier by an officer who said they were for laboratory experiments. The very first shipment was intercepted by the Germans before a single rat was used. The Germans displayed them at their military schools and searched for more, believing hundreds were already out there. SOE's own report called the trouble this caused a much greater success than if the rats had actually been used.

The boiler explosion shown is the plan, not something that happened. Where the shipment was seized isn't recorded in the sources we used.
